title: PYRE plugin metadata
description: Metadata file (plugin.json) of a single plugin repository. The index build validates the same rules without external dependencies.

name.description: Command name used to invoke the plugin. The "_name_" form is the recommended style, but any identifier is valid.

title.description: Human readable name shown in the index table.

description.description: One line: what the example demonstrates.

since.description: First version of the plugin that provides the example.

config.description: Copied as-is into the plugin section of the PYRE settings.

file.description: Plugin entry file, a path inside the package: "hello.py", or "panel/__init__.py" for a package directory.

cache.description: Reuse the module from sys.modules instead of re-importing it.

api.description: Pass the full plugin API to main/hook_run instead of an empty dict.

hooks.description: Hook names handled by hook_run; __any__ subscribes to every hook.
